config.inventory-sorter-ultimate.title: InventorySorterUltimate Settings
config.inventory-sorter-ultimate.enabled: Enable or disable inventory and container sorting.
config.inventory-sorter-ultimate.delay.t: Delay in ticks between moving items when sorting (0 = fastest, 1 = default).
config.inventory-sorter-ultimate.disable: Disables the inventory sorter while in Creative mode so middle-click item cloning works normally.
config.inventory-sorter-ultimate.sort_ke: Click to bind any mouse button or keyboard key (Press ESC to unbind).
